paste0("sample_", 1:3)   ) )  sparse_cpu <- cuda_sparse(counts, device = "cpu") sparse_info(sparse_cpu) #> $shape #> [1] 4 3 #>  #> $nnz #> [1] 6 #>  #> $density #> [1] 0.5 #>  #> $format #> [1] "csr" #>  fallback output_device #>     FALSE           cpu dense <- matrix(   seq_len(6) / 10,   nrow = 3,   dimnames = list(     sample = paste0("sample_", 1:3),     component = c("component_1", text: public R torch API provides documented COO constructor. CUDA objects therefore use coalesced torch COO tensor internally even logical format recorded CSR. CSR metadata still exposed future native cuSPARSE integration. first release, dense products returned CPU CUDA computation. Use cudatensr::cuda_diagnostics() inspect runtime cuda_provenance() inspect actual stages. backend provenance tutorial contains runnable CPU examples, optional CUDA path, sparse memory transfer limitations, NVIDIA hardware-test contract. table describes cuda_sparse() construction. CUDA sparse-dense multiplication currently returns dense result CPU, row/column reductions fixed-CPU Matrix stages. Consult cuda_provenance() instead inferring end--end backend input object. Printing objects 100 stored values shows metadata, avoiding unexpected full sparse-matrix materialization. Use to_dgCMatrix(x) need complete R Matrix, change display threshold options(cudasparsr.max_print = 500). installation, device verification, memory advice, common failures, see cudaverse GPU setup troubleshooting guide.

title: cudasparsr 0.2.0
text: cuda_provenance() now re-exports canonical cudatensr S3 generic instead wrapping , methods registered cudaverse packages remain available regardless package attachment order. Adopted shared cudaverse-stage/1 provenance contract sparse construction, materialization, multiplication, matrix-vector products, reductions. CUDA multiplication followed CPU materialization now represented hybrid execution. Fixed cuda_sparse(existing, drop_zeros = TRUE) otherwise reusable cudasparse object longer bypasses removal explicitly stored zeros. sparse_info() now reports provenance schema aggregate compute device.

title: cudasparsr 0.1.2
text: Sparse row column names now retained across construction, format conversion, CPU/CUDA storage, dgCMatrix round-trips, products, reductions. Labeled sparse-dense products reject incompatible contracted dimensions.

title: cudasparsr 0.1.1
text: Large sparse objects now print compact metadata summary without materializing complete dgCMatrix; threshold controlled options(cudasparsr.max_print = 100). drop_zeros now requires one non-missing logical value instead silently treating invalid values FALSE. Declared cudatensr (>= 0.1.1) tested dense-core compatibility floor.
